description: Litecoin network and node statistics from our own full node. When to use: network difficulty or hashrate, chain transaction throughput, node version, peers, uptime, relay fee or index health. Do not use: for fee advice (ltc_get_fee_rates), mempool depth (ltc_get_mempool_state) or a transaction lookup (ltc_get_transaction). Returns: difficulty, network_hashrate_hs, chain_tx_count_total, tx_rate_per_s, window_blocks/window_tx_count, protocol_version, client, connections, relay_fee_ltc_kvb, mempool_txs, uptime_s, indexes.
name: ltc_get_network_stats
title: Ltc Get Network Stats
